messages:
Dalia: Postmortem follow-up: we saw three vendor-related cascades over the past 10 days. Trying to lock owners + verification steps so these fixes actually land.
Omar: which cascades are we tracking specifically?
Dalia: Pattern: cloud auth throttles -> model-registry token refreshes fail (401/429) -> client retries + sticky routing block cross-region failover -> queue growth and SLO blips.
Ben: I captured logs: concurrent refreshes spike >100, then we hit provider rate limits.
Rina: Impact recap: ~2min spikes of elevated tail latency, small % of requests failed with 503 during the worst windows.
sre-oncall-bot: Follow-up incident recorded: INC-2027-02-22-334. Owners reminded in 48h.
Dalia: Proposed owners and minimal deliverables:
- C1: Omar -> vendor comms & SLA ask. Open SR, ask for rate-limit windows and prioritized channel. Deliverable: SR + vendor response summary. ETA: 7 business days.
- C2: Ben -> model-registry client: limit concurrent token refreshes, add prefetch + singleflight, and jittered exp backoff for 429s. Deliverable: PR + integration test. ETA: 4 business days.
- C3: Rina -> routing behavior: reduce sticky TTL to 20s for model-registry routes and add explicit on-auth-error alternate-region failover. Deliverable: canary + rollout plan. ETA: 6 business days.
- C4: Dalia -> postmortem doc update + recurring incident dashboard card. Deliverable: updated doc + dashboard link. ETA: EOD next business day.
- C5: infra -> synthetic job: inject 429 bursts and verify retry storm detection + alert. Owner: infra (I'll assign to infra team). Deliverable: job + alert rule. ETA: 5 business days.
Omar: I'll open SR-90234 and ask for historical throttle windows. I'll request a maintenance window SLA and a designated on-call contact.
Ben: Implementation notes: I'll add singleflight so only one refresh happens per key, cap concurrent refreshes to 5, and treat 429 with a longer backoff. Example pseudo: ```
// pseudo singleflight + backoff
if tokenExpired() {
  singleflight.call(key, func(){
    doRefresh()
  })
}
if status==429 {
  sleep = base * 2^attempt + rand(0,base) + 1200ms
}
```
Rina: For routing canary: 10% traffic -> 48h -> monitor p95 latency, token-miss rate, and failover activation. Rollback if p95 > baseline * 1.12 or token-miss rate > 0.8%.
Dalia: Add one security/ops check: C6: Ben/Rina -> run a quick threat review to ensure token prefetch doesn't leak scopes or extend lifetimes unintentionally. Deliverable: short security note. ETA: 3 business days.
Ben: noted, will ping security for a 30m review.
sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: C2 due in 4 business days.
Dalia: Also: verification plan - once PRs and routing change are merged, infra should run the synthetic 429 job for 3 consecutive runs with PASS before we close items.
Omar: vendor SR opened: SR-90234. Will paste vendor reply in the follow-up doc when available.
Ben: I'll post PR link and CI results to the postmortem doc.
Rina: I'll draft the canary runbook and include exact telemetry queries.
Dalia: Scheduling a 30m check-in in 48h to confirm owners' progress. @deploy-bot can you schedule? Keep thread chatter minimal; update the postmortem follow-up doc instead.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Auth & Registry Follow-up" Mon Feb 24 11:00am PT. Invite: Dalia, Omar, Ben, Rina.
sre-oncall-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 48h.
Omar: Will coordinate infra run with synthetic job once Ben's PR is ready.
Ben: Will include unit + integration tests to simulate provider 429s.
Rina: Will prepare rollback steps if canary shows regression.
Dalia: Thanks team. Closing thread; we'll reconvene at the 48h check-in.
